[7:13PM] #Anthony #Ketu #TrafficUpdate 

High vehicular influx from the foot of Dorman Long bridge towards Fadeyi, Onipanu down to Palm Grove.
Obanikoro approaching Anthony is also slow due to the high vehicular movement negotiating from Corona Loop to Ikorodu road main carriage way. 
Anthony towards Idiroko Maryland, Odo'yalaro up to New Garage is slow as well, New garage, Ojota and Interchange is also slow. This is due to return journey rush couple with traffic diversion as a result of  expansion joint repair on going at Ifako.

Further movement from Interchange inw Tipper Garage is moving expectedly onward Demurin junction and Ketu. 
Ketu toward Kosofe is a fast moving traffic. 

Return journey from Kosofe towards Ketu and Interchange. Motorways down to Ojota both the service lane and the main carriage way are all good.
New garage, Odo'yalaro, Independence Tunnel is good.
Idiroko, Anthony is good on the main carriage way, but busy at service lane due to traffic extension from Town Planning.

Anthony onward Obanikoro Palm Grove, Onipan up to Fadeyi are presently good.

Officers are on ground, very visible controlling and managing the the situation.
